analytical_answers.Q1_objective_improvement: Offline capability breadth grew enormously (M4 1 system-score to M15 full research platform; tests 260->459). Live overall: +0.08 (0.55->0.63) across incompatible projects/scorers - not a provable gain. Honest answer: engineering + offline discovery improved; live-investigation discovery did not (0.0 in all 6 strict live runs).
analytical_answers.Q2_most_improved: Engineering reliability (260->459 tests; budget compliance restored after M7 breach); offline discovery (0.938/0.906 evidence-required means); durability/reproducibility (1.0 every live run); cost discipline (all runs under caps).
analytical_answers.Q3_stagnated_regressed: Live discovery (0.4 partial-credit M5, then 0.0 x6); reasoning dimension frozen at 0.6 x7 runs; M7 experiment-cap breach (fixed); report validity M5 invalid -> M6 valid -> M7 invalid -> M8 invalid-by-absence (unstable).
analytical_answers.Q4_discovery_reliability: Offline: yes (5/8 + controls, precision 1.0 when naming, Wilson CI wide [0.31,0.86]). Live: no (0 confirmed in 6 strict runs; zero false positives preserved - reliability as restraint, not as finding power).
analytical_answers.Q5_causal_reasoning: Offline improved (0.75 M9; confounder handling introduced). Live causal-diagnosis stuck at 0.5 (M6/M7) with qualitative-only thereafter; schema-vs-district confounding unresolved live.
analytical_answers.Q6_multi_agent: +0.085 (+12.4%) team over single, but n=1 scenario per milestone and identical values across different scenarios; benefit is unproven statistically; cost overhead bounded (<=1 extra call).
analytical_answers.Q7_generalization: Offline yes: 8+8+6+6+4 scenarios, 5+ frameworks with honest TF/HF guards, unfamiliar columns (zone/day/county/machine/sensor) discovered. Live: unproven (7 runs, 5 projects, 0 discoveries).
analytical_answers.Q8_efficiency: Per-investigation cost stable $0.031-$0.058 (mean $0.0438); tokens 28k-44k (mean ~34k); no cost growth with capability growth. Cost per resolved live hypothesis: undefined (no live resolution occurred).
analytical_answers.Q9_reproducibility: Strongest dimension: reproducibility 1.0 in all 7 live runs; manifests + hashes + preserved failures; determinism byte-identical offline (M9 408 means unchanged by attribution fix).
Q10_largest_weaknesses: Live discovery 0/6 strict runs (slice-aware probes missing from live path)
Reasoning dimension frozen at 0.6 across all 7 live runs (mechanism pinning fails)
Single-live-sample per milestone (n=1; no within-milestone variance estimable)
analytical_answers.Q11_M16_first: Wire slice-aware/ranking-P@K probes + skeptic/judge-lite into the live loop and re-test on eval_music/eval_credit repeats (paired, same scorer); second: multi-run live campaigns (n>=5) so variance/CIs exist.
